text:
Nina V: Quick sync — AuroraPay wants to run a short POC to migrate off CompetitorWave. Main asks: adapter header mapping, prompt/response shape differences, billing delta estimate, and webhook retry semantics. Can SE/security assist? cc @Omar H @Tess P
Omar H: They send mostly single-shot completions + embeddings, with a few streaming progress websockets. Need their top-150 anonymized calls. Also ask: exact token parity or semantic parity?
Nina V: Product cares about semantic parity for UX; procurement cares about predictable cost during the POC.
Tess P: Pricing: we can offer a capped POC fee for 10 days. Commercial will draft a capped quote; production remains per-token. RevOps approval required for flat POCs.
SecurityAlice: Security checklist: EU residency (eu-west), SAML SSO for admin, weekly audit export, webhook HMAC signature, and possible customer-managed KMS. Hosted supports HMAC+IP allowlist; Dedicated required for CMK/HSM and mTLS callbacks. Please upload their questionnaire to secure uploader. Link to our security pack: https://redwood.example/security-pack
Omar H: Technical plan (short): 1) Handshake (day 0-1): creds, sample cURLs, header mapping; 2) Parity smoke (day 2-3): run 500 prompts side-by-side, collect token counts and semantic diffs; 3) Billing replay (day 4): estimate token delta and cap; 4) Scale (day 5): ramp to p95 and check fallbacks.
Omar H: Handshake snippet to give their engineers:
```
# exchange token
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/auth/token -d '{"client_id":"AP-POC","client_secret":"..."}'
# completion
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rw-medium-1","input":"Show my last transactions"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
# webhook example header
X-RW-Signature: sha256=... (HMAC-SHA256)
```
Nina V: CompetitorWave uses X-CW-Sig and X-CW-ReqId. We should include a mapping table and an adapter snippet so they can drop-in replace headers during the POC.
Tess P: Acceptance criteria proposal: 1) semantic parity >= 90% on spot-checks, 2) token cost delta <= 18% for POC workload, 3) p95 latency < 300ms for single-shot gen, 4) webhook delivery >= 99% with retries.
SecurityAlice: If AuroraPay insists on mTLS for callbacks, advise Dedicated and note lead time. I'll review questionnaire and prepare signature-mapping + IDS rules.
EngOpsBot: Note: customer-managed KMS and mTLS require enterprise contract addendum. See https://redwood.example/ent/kms
Nina V: Owners: Omar (tech), Tess (commercial), SecurityAlice (security). I'll ask AuroraPay for sample prompts and the questionnaire now. :thumbsup:
